{{Quote|There's however some areas that we don't like to see defiled by anyone, namely our gravesites. That's why I check up on them now and then and listen carefully for rumors about someone planning a trip out to them.|[[Omkoo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GR" />}}
An '''Aqualish gravesite''' was built on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] long before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was one of the oldest [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] gravesites on Talus. Although the Aqualish did not care about their ancient buildings, mostly in ruins, they always preserved their old gravesites.<ref name="SWG:GR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Aqualish [[Omkoo]] was concerned by rumors of thugs vandalizing Aqualish gravesites.<ref name="SWG:GR" /> As the local [[Federation of the Double Worlds]] authorities seemed indifferent to this situation,<ref name="SWG:QH">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Friday%20Feature%20-%20Quest%20Highlights|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Quest Highlights}}</ref> the Aqualish hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to investigate and stop disturbing the graves. However, the spacer did not find thugs at the Aqualish gravesite but [[TTLP soldiers|paramilitary forces]] of the [[Tralus and Talus Liberation Party]],<ref name="SWG:GR" /> a group fighting for the independence of the [[Double Worlds|Twin Worlds]] from the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="SWG:TLP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=loading|Talus Liberation Party|Talus}}</ref> The spacer killed the soldiers plundering the ruins but the TTLP had already shipped off some artifacts. The adventurer then visited the [[Nashal Starport]] and a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Weapons Depot|weapons depot]] where all stolen artifacts were finally retrieved.<ref name="SWG:GR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Aqualish gravesite was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Aqualish gravesite was added to the game with the quest "[[W:c:swg:Grave Robbers|Grave Robbers]]" released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
